text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to amend the existing by-law authorizing the installation of speed humps on Flamborough Drive to accommodate one additional speed hump.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Approved the installation of one additional speed hump on Flamborough Drive between Keele Street and Culford Road. 2. Amended Drawing "NY-1470, May 2003" with drawing "421G-3898, August 2021", attached to the report (August 23, 2021) from the Acting Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
